# Template catalogue

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-references.mjs — edit runtime/templates/index.mjs instead -->

Templates return a complete MotionSpec bound to selectors you pass as parameters; their `stage` markup is used for previews and `export --targets scaffold`. Always bind selectors to the project's real markup:

```
RM design --project . --template stagger-list --param selector=.inbox-row --param eachMs=40
```

Compose several into one spec with an input file:

```json
{ "compose": [ { "template": "gradient-drift" }, { "template": "particle-field", "params": { "count": 80 } } ], "id": "hero-bg" }
```

## `spring-pop` — Spring pop entrance

Element scales up from a smaller size with a real damped spring (Apple-style response/dampingFraction).

Purpose: **entrance** · Capabilities: spring-physics, keyframes

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selector` | string | `".rm-pop"` | Element to animate. |
| `fromScale` | number (0–1) | `0.85` | Starting scale (0.8–0.95 reads natural; avoid 0). |
| `response` | number (0.1–2) | `0.45` | Spring response in seconds (period of the undamped oscillation). |
| `dampingFraction` | number (0.1–2) | `0.62` | 1 = no bounce, 0.5–0.8 = lively. |
| `delayMs` | number | `0` | Start delay. |
| `trigger` | string | `"onLoad"` | onLoad \| onClick \| onScroll \| manual |

## `shared-element` — Shared-element card → detail (FLIP)

A card morphs into its detail view by animating the measured geometry difference (First-Last-Invert-Play) with a spring; reverse on close.

Purpose: **transition** · Capabilities: spring-physics, flip, layers

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | string | `".rm-card"` | Source element (thumbnail/card). |
| `to` | string | `".rm-detail"` | Destination element (expanded view). |
| `response` | number | `0.42` | Spring response (s). |
| `dampingFraction` | number | `0.86` | Damping fraction; ~0.85 for large surfaces (no visible wobble). |
| `trigger` | string | `"onClick"` | onClick (click source to open, again to close) \| manual |

## `glass-window` — Frosted-glass window expand / collapse

A translucent panel (static backdrop blur) springs open from its trigger and collapses on the next click; mid-flight clicks reverse from the current position.

Purpose: **transition** · Capabilities: spring-physics, filters, keyframes, interruptible

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selector` | string | `".rm-glass"` | Panel element. |
| `triggerSelector` | string | `".rm-glass-toggle"` | Element whose click toggles the panel. |
| `origin` | string | `"top left"` | transform-origin, i.e. where the trigger sits relative to the panel. |
| `response` | number | `0.38` | Spring response (s). |
| `dampingFraction` | number | `0.82` | Damping fraction. |
| `fromScale` | number | `0.9` | Collapsed scale. |

## `svg-path-draw` — SVG path draw-on

Strokes draw themselves using pathLength="1" + stroke-dashoffset (no length measurement), staggered per path.

Purpose: **entrance** · Capabilities: svg, path, keyframes, stagger

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selector` | string | `".rm-path"` | SVG <path>/<line>/<circle> elements with pathLength="1" and stroke-dasharray: 1. |
| `durationMs` | number | `900` | Per-path draw time. |
| `eachMs` | number | `120` | Stagger between paths. |
| `easing` | string | `"ease-in-out-cubic"` | Draw easing. |

## `stagger-list` — Staggered list entrance

Items rise and fade in one after another; total cascade stays short so the last item is not late.

Purpose: **entrance** · Capabilities: stagger, keyframes, choreography

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selector` | string | `".rm-item"` | Repeated item selector. |
| `eachMs` | number | `45` | Delay step between items (30–60ms for lists). |
| `distance` | number | `14` | Rise distance in px. |
| `durationMs` | number | `420` | Per-item duration. |
| `from` | string | `"start"` | start \| center \| end |
| `count` | number | `6` | Item count in the preview stage. |

## `particle-field` — Particle field (canvas)

Deterministic seeded particles drift and twinkle on a DPR-capped canvas; pauses off-screen and when the tab is hidden; one static frame under reduced motion.

Purpose: **ambient** · Capabilities: particles, canvas

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selector` | string | `".rm-particles"` | Container element (canvas is appended, absolutely positioned). |
| `count` | number | `90` | Particle count (≤ 150 recommended for phones). |
| `colors` | array | `#ffffff, #a5c8ff, #ffd6f5` | Particle colors. |
| `speed` | number | `22` | Drift speed in px/s. |
| `seed` | number | `7` | Random seed (deterministic output). |

## `gradient-drift` — Dynamic gradient background

Blurred color blobs drift on long, offset loops. Only transform animates (compositor); the blur is static.

Purpose: **ambient** · Capabilities: gradient, layers, filters, keyframes

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selector` | string | `".rm-blob"` | Blob elements inside a clipped container. |
| `durationMs` | number | `14000` | Loop length (ambient loops ≥ 8s read as calm). |
| `distance` | number | `80` | Travel in px. |
| `colors` | array | `#5b6cff, #ff5fa2, #2ee6c5` | Blob colors (preview stage). |

## `mask-reveal` — Mask (clip-path) reveal

Content is revealed by an expanding inset clip-path with a slight settle.

Purpose: **entrance** · Capabilities: mask, keyframes

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selector` | string | `".rm-reveal"` | Element to reveal. |
| `durationMs` | number | `700` | Duration. |
| `edge` | string | `"bottom"` | bottom \| left \| center |

## `blur-in` — Blur-in text

Words sharpen from a soft blur while rising slightly; small blur radius keeps paint cost low.

Purpose: **entrance** · Capabilities: filters, keyframes, stagger

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selector` | string | `".rm-word"` | Word/line elements. |
| `eachMs` | number | `60` | Stagger step. |
| `blur` | number | `8` | Start blur in px (keep ≤ 10). |

## `morph-blob` — Organic shape morph

A shape morphs via border-radius keyframes while slowly rotating (border-radius repaints; keep the element small).

Purpose: **ambient** · Capabilities: morph, keyframes

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selector` | string | `".rm-morph"` | Shape element. |
| `durationMs` | number | `8000` | Loop length. |

## `layer-parallax` — Layered depth entrance

Foreground, midground and background layers settle with different travel distances and timings, creating depth.

Purpose: **entrance** · Capabilities: layers, choreography, keyframes

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `back` | string | `".rm-layer-back"` | Background layer. |
| `mid` | string | `".rm-layer-mid"` | Midground layer. |
| `front` | string | `".rm-layer-front"` | Foreground layer. |
| `distance` | number | `40` | Foreground travel in px. |

## `press-feedback` — Press feedback

A quick scale-down/settle on press (≈160ms) to acknowledge input without delaying it.

Purpose: **feedback** · Capabilities: keyframes, micro-interaction

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selector` | string | `".rm-press"` | Pressable element. |
| `scale` | number | `0.96` | Pressed scale. |
